title: Montauk experiments

tellings.quote: I believe that there was like this machinery they found at Montalk and blanking on the name of the author of the book, but Preston something

plain: The story goes that secret experiments ran at Montauk, on the tip of Long Island, New York, sometime between the 1950s and the late 1960s, and that some kind of machinery was found there. Michels raises it himself and says he believes in that machinery. He points to a book whose author he half remembers as "Preston something", meaning Preston Nichols, but he gives no details from it.
